instruction: Download receipts of all my amazon orders in "~/bills/shopping_amazon/" folder in my file system. Name the files in the format, "ordered-at-yyyy-mm-dd-order-id-<order_id>.txt". Replace <order_id> with the actual order id, and yyyy-mm-dd with the date when the order was placed. You should be able to find receipts from order confirmation emails.
notes: Ground truth changes amazon.Order plus file_system File/Directory, so receipts are fetched with amazon.download_order_receipt (download_to_file_path + file_system_access_token) rather than from gmail attachments; the email hint is informational only. The number of orders is unknown a priori, so three placeholder orders are declared as domain constants (needed so supervisor-complete-task can enumerate all goal conditions without quantification); at runtime the download step is repeated once per order returned by amazon.show_orders and the file name is built from the order id and the placement date. amazon.show_orders asserts the knowledge predicate (orders-listed) that gates every download. The target directory is created explicitly (recursive=true) before downloading, which matches the Directory model change; no answer is passed to complete_task.
